== Summary ==
Promotional screenshot of the Dark Side playmat in Star Wars CCG (HiRez) on Tabletop Simulator, published by Tolban, with Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand in play. Source: the item's Steam Workshop page, published by Tolban.
